summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for Learning Space, a local-first, NotebookLM-inspired modular AI learning studio featuring multi-modal asset viewers/editors (Markdown with LaTeX, interactive PPX slide/infographic editor, runnable Jupyter notebooks, concept graphs, PDF reader, and timestamp-commented audio/video), grounded chat with Live Voice mode, and a node-based visual flow builder for Actions and Model Config routing, alongside the four foundational agent specification documents.
